🧠 Crypto News Brief: Risk appetite is back: bitcoin is parked near $87,000 as a US reserve bill clears committee and ETFs pull in nearly $1 billion. But regulators in Washington and Frankfurt are tightening the screws. 🏛️ US Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Bill Clears House Committee as BTC Holds Near $87,000 The American Reserve Modernization Act passed the House Financial Services Committee 28–21, the furthest any bitcoin reserve bill has travelled through Congress. It would move the roughly 325,000 BTC the government already holds — most of it seized in forfeitures — into a Treasury-run Strategic Bitcoin Reserve, lock the coins up for at least 20 years and require quarterly audited proof they are still there. Bitcoin held near $86,900 on the news while Zcash led the majors with a 10% jump, helped by sliding oil prices and softer Treasury yields. Read full story ⚖️ DOJ Probes Binance Over Alleged Iran Sanctions Violations Federal prosecutors in Manhattan, working alongside the Justice Department's criminal division, are examining whether Binance knowingly permitted trading that breached US sanctions on Iran, according to Bloomberg, with Reuters separately corroborating the inquiry. It is the first public account of investigators focusing on the exchange's own conduct rather than on its users. Binance says it maintains zero tolerance for sanctions violations and cooperates fully with law enforcement. The probe lands nearly three years after the exchange's $4.3 billion guilty plea and the installation of two corporate monitors. More details 📈 Spot Bitcoin ETFs Pull In $999M — Ninth Largest Inflow on Record US-listed spot bitcoin ETFs absorbed a net $998.95 million on Monday, their biggest single session since bitcoin's October 2025 record high and the ninth largest since the products launched in January 2024. BlackRock's IBIT led with $381 million, ahead of ARK's ARKB at $289 million and Fidelity's FBTC at $239 million. The burst came days after a failed Senate cloture vote on the Clarity Act and a Fed rate increase, reading as institutional conviction rather than retreat. September's tally now stands at $1.31 billion. Read more 🪙 Binance Takes $100M Circle Stake in Five-Year USDC Deal Circle sold Binance 1.24 million Class A shares at $80.84 each in a private placement that closed on 17 September, disclosed this week in an SEC filing.
